notes: Round-89 C2 supplementary criteria-side cases: one per routed round-88 C1 survivor (R88MResidMut §3.1). Expectations follow upstream mako 1.11.0 (criteria.c match_criteria strcmp for app-name and mode; apply_criteria_field accepts a bare !token for boolean fields only; mako.5 L45 include is a global option) and the tool's refusal stance.

cases.pin: criteria.c match_criteria: strcmp(criteria->app_name, notif->app_name) — case-sensitive; kills RM2C1
criteria.c apply_criteria_field: a bare (value-less) token is tried against boolean fields only; !app-name is an error; kills RM3C1
criteria.c match_criteria: mode compared with strcmp against each enabled mode; kills RM5C1
mako.5 L45: include is a global configuration option; inside a criteria section the tool refuses it; kills RM7C1
